description: Line-chart layout spaced by date (#1370, spec change; PROTOTYPE_SPEC section 0, 2026-10-30). Box {W:320,H:150,px:34,py:16}: plot width W-px-8 = 278 (x from 34 to 312), plot height 118 (y 16 at the max, 134 at the min). x = 34 + 278 * (days from the first date to this date) / (days from the first to the last). All days are calendar days. When the first and last date are the same day, points are spread evenly by index. y is unchanged from the prototype: 16 + (max - v) * 118 / (max - min), range under 1 widened by 0.5 each way. Expected values worked by hand from this description.

cases.note: 3 and 7 days apart: offsets 0, 3, 10 of 10 -> x 34, 34+83.4, 312 (index spacing would give 173)
across a month end: offsets 0, 4, 7 of 7 -> x 34, 34+158.857142..., 312
across the EU clock change (29 Mar 2026): offsets 0, 1, 3 of 3 -> x 34, 34+92.666..., 312
evenly spaced dates give the same x as index spacing: offsets 0, 7, 14 of 14
every point on one date: spread evenly by index, x 34, 173, 312
two points, any gap: the ends, x 34 and 312; a range under 1 is widened (80..80.4 -> 79.5..80.9, 1.4 tall)
